scope_note: This is a live-model quality evaluation over controlled synthetic fixtures. It is not the >=20-case real-task baseline and does not prove cross-harness behavioral parity.

known_environment_noise: Codex emitted a non-fatal warning for an unrelated malformed global growthops-engineering skill.
Benchmark payloads were inlined into isolated sessions; no external actions were requested.

method: Compile each fixture with Fikri SOUL + canonical compiler skill in a separate live-model session.
Run a downstream arm from authoritative original context.
Run a separate downstream arm from compiled context only.
Score token reduction and machine-detectable protected/source atoms.
Blind-review original and compiled downstream responses as A/B without revealing which arm is which.

summary.exact_required_phrase_recall_note: Diagnostic only. Surface-language translation changes exact phrase matching, so semantic downstream acceptance is decided by the blind fidelity review plus exact protected/source atom checks.
